Notifications

Get alerted when grabs happen, imports complete, or something goes wrong.

Supported providers

ProviderTypeSetup needed
DiscordWebhookDiscord channel webhook URL
TelegramBot APIBot token + Chat ID
SlackIncoming webhookSlack webhook URL
EmailSMTPSMTP server, port, credentials, from/to addresses
Generic webhookHTTP POSTAny URL — NGMS POSTs JSON

Adding a Discord notification

1

Create a Discord webhook

In Discord: Channel Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook. Copy the webhook URL.

2

Settings → Notifications → Add → Discord

Paste the webhook URL. Give it a name and optionally an avatar URL.

3

Choose events

Select which events trigger this notification. Each provider can be configured independently for different event sets.

Notification events

EventWhen it fires
On GrabA release was sent to the download client
On ImportA file was successfully imported to the library
On UpgradeA file was replaced with a better quality version
On Download FailureDownload client reported a failure
On Import FailureFile could not be matched or imported
On RenameExisting files were renamed (e.g. after template change)
On Health IssueNGMS health check detected a problem
On Application UpdateNGMS restarted with a new version
✦
Use the Test button on any configured notification to send a test message before relying on it in production.
